Name: Delightful Deer
Author: nugmods
Description:
My original sprites for Mizu's Deer, inspired heavily by the artistic styles of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Siamece[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21024]Cajcbell[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2964]Kwillow[/url]! Covers all the default and extra deer skins and babies, too! And yes these were very much inspired by Bambi <3

[b]Install:[/b]
Just put it in your mods folder, I promise it's that easy

[b]Credits:[/b]
Artistic Inspiration:  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Siamece[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21024]Cajcbell[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2964]Kwillow[/url], whose animal textures I use in my own game, and thus these sprites are designed to match
Mizu: for the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45939]deer mod
